findings.description: SessionStore::is_persistent() returns true for open/try_open and false for in_memory. Unit-tested in 3 new tests in crates/chronos-store/src/storage.rs.
ChronosServer::is_degraded() returns true for an in-memory test store and false for a persistent store. Unit-tested in 1 new test in crates/chronos-mcp/src/server.rs.

session_envelope(degraded, value) helper preserves the existing JSON object shape and adds a single top-level `degraded` key. Defensive fallback wraps non-object values into {result, degraded} so the wire contract stays an object.
findings.mitigation: Verified with 2 unit tests (object injection + non-object wrap).

findings.description: Real-tool envelope assertions: list_sessions and save_session both include `degraded: true` at the top level when the server is built from an in-memory store, and the existing fields (session_count, sessions, session_id, status, etc.) are preserved unchanged.
findings.mitigation: Verified with 2 round-trip tests that decode the JSON content and assert on the parsed shape.

summary: Closes FIND-M9-75-MCP-TOOLS-DO-NOT-DISCLOSE-DEGRADED-STORE. Adds a StoreKind enum to SessionStore (Persistent | InMemory) and a pub fn is_persistent() accessor; adds a ChronosServer::is_degraded() accessor backed by a `degraded: bool` field set once at construction; and wires a `degraded: <bool>` top-level field into the JSON envelopes of save_session, list_sessions, load_session, delete_session, and drop_session via a session_envelope() helper. T0 + T2 + T3 + T4-smoke (chronos-sandbox subset: e2e_connectivity, session_persistence, session_lifecycle) all pass; 5 new tests in chronos-mcp (87/0) and 3 new tests in chronos-store (77/0); downstream chronos-services 264/0. Workspace clippy clean. Spec correction: the proposal and earlier spec draft named the tools with underscores-as-separators (session_save/session_list/session_load); the actual MCP tool names registered in server.rs are save_session, list_sessions, load_session, delete_session, drop_session. Spec and proposal amended mid-cycle with a note.
